subject.title: fix(ui): keep composer on Send when run-status toast expires (#88033)

question: Should maintainers require live browser/Gateway proof after the branch is refreshed, or explicitly override the proof gate for this intermittent WebChat timing race?
rationale: The source-level race is plausible and covered by fake timers, but repository review policy treats visible UI behavior proof as a merge gate unless a maintainer intentionally accepts an override.

options.title: Require refreshed proof
options.body: Port the patch to the current paths and require redacted live browser/Gateway proof before merging.

options.title: Override proof after source review
options.body: A maintainer may accept the fake-timer regression as sufficient for this intermittent race, but that should be an explicit proof override.

options.title: Wait for broader false-busy work
options.body: Pause this PR until the related broader false-busy PR proves whether it fully covers the toast-expiry symptom.

recommendation.title: Require refreshed proof
recommendation.body: Port the patch to the current paths and require redacted live browser/Gateway proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current assignee and has adjacent recent chat UI history, so he is the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency call.
